author: sarimabbas

scripts.test: npm run native && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && assets/key-sender --self-test
scripts.verify:source: npm test && python3 scripts/check-modifier-events.py && python3 scripts/check-saved-mutants.py && python3 scripts/check-mutants.py && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:source && npm run build && npm run check:boundary:mutants && npm run check:boundary
scripts.checks: npm run verify:source && npm run validate:store
scripts.lint:source: eslint src tests && prettier --check src tests
